notes: Five modules in four files: url_unwrap (P064), urlscan_search (P066), url_domain_blocklists + url_domain_blocklists_c2 (P071, one file), secret_scanner (P312). Every final condition is implemented or recorded in docs/backlog/p1-G03-1.md with its unblock condition. Decisions to confirm: (1) P071 - url_domain_blocklists is terms 'noncommercial' at module level (its most restrictive sources, OpenPhish and Phishing Army) while each dataset part carries its own source and terms; the corporate profile removes those two sources through the policy gate, OpenPhish additionally needs the written-consent reference setting; (2) P071 - CyberCrime-Tracker (anonymous operator, tier unknown) is the separate non-default class url_domain_blocklists_c2 (A3); PhishTank is registered disabled (keyless dumps 404, keyed URL cannot be templated); (3) P071 - a URL listing propagates to its host only for ordinary hosts (never path platforms, PSL-private tenants or protected domains), and a feed that listed the exact URL is not counted again for the host; Botvrij is a frozen list (historical hits only); (4) P312 cond 4 - password-type values keep no digest at all (stricter than 'type + SHA-256': a hash of a password is a password hash, rule 3), their findings are keyed by location; (5) P312 - when the same secret matches a gitleaks rule and a V3LUM kit rule, the kit rule is the primary rule id (its exfil tag drives severity); (6) P064 - destination pivots of URLs that carry recipient identifiers are expand=False and flagged (A7), WhatsApp/Telegram personal pivots are always expand=False. Positive secret vectors are generated at test time from each rule's own pattern (no token-shaped value is committed). Test infrastructure note: one combined run hit a transient failure in a tmp-dir-dependent test that never reproduced in 7 reruns; concurrent pytest sessions of other agents prune /tmp/pytest-of-root basetemps, so the batch runs used --basetemp in the scratchpad. Tests: 105 batch offline tests pass (url_unwrap 25, urlscan_search 25, url_domain_blocklists 26, url_domain_blocklists_c2 10, secret_scanner 19); tests/test_registry_contract.py passes for the five modules; ruff clean; P327 lint (lint_module_source/lint_data_file) 0 issues on the modules and data fragments; live (V3LUM_LIVE=1) 10/10 passed; full offline suite 5195 passed, 29 failed, 76 skipped - none of the failures in this batch (other batches in progress: ransomfeed, typosquat/bcb, archive_listing, bcb_authorized_institutions, file_type_sniff, subdomains_passive, warninglists; core under review: test_context, test_datasets, test_engine_status_mapping, test_links, test_noise, test_scope, notice fragments).
